environment.description: Spring Boot 2.7 application deployed on EC2 behind an NLB (Network Load Balancer, Layer 4 only). PostgreSQL 14 database with standard role 'app_user' that has SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE on all tables. No Row-Level Security policies are enabled. The products table contains data for all tenants with a tenant_id column. The SET app.current_tenant command executes but no RLS policy references it. Database connection pool uses a single shared role with no pg_hba.conf restrictions beyond password auth.

config.db_role: app_user with broad SELECT on all tenant data
